key.name: callsign
key.description: Your amateur radio callsign.

key.name: location
key.description: Your station location or QTH.

key.name: spot-message
key.description: Default spot message to use when posting.

key.name: first-run-setup-complete
key.description: Whether the first-time setup dialog has already been completed or skipped.

key.name: spot-alerts-enabled
key.description: Show notifications when matching POTA spots appear.

key.description: Keyword rules used to match POTA spots for alerts.

key.name: update-interval
key.description: How often to refresh spots, in seconds.

key.name: default-band
key.description: The default frequency band (in meters).

key.name: default-mode
key.description: The default operating mode.

key.name: qrz-api-key
key.description: API key for QRZ.com lookups.

key.name: show-logbook
key.description: Show the experimental Logbook window and related shortcuts.

key.name: radio-connection-type
key.description: How to connect to the radio (none, serial/USB, network).

key.name: radio-model
key.description: Hamlib radio model ID number.

key.name: radio-device
key.description: Device path for serial/USB connection (e.g., /dev/ttyUSB0 or COM3).

key.name: radio-network-host
key.description: Hostname or IP address for network connection.

key.name: radio-network-port
key.description: Port number for network connection.

key.description: Listen for WSJT-X UDP packets for logged contacts and heard spots.

key.description: UDP port used to receive WSJT-X packets.

key.name: forward-wsjtx-qsos-to-qrz

key.description: Baud rate for serial connection.

key.description: Data bits for serial connection.

key.description: Stop bits for serial connection.

key.name: hide-older-than

key.description: Highlight spot cards for parks you haven't hunted before.

key.name: hide-qrt
key.description: Hide stations that have marked themselves QRT

key.name: hide-hunted
key.description: Hide parks you've hunted today

key.description: Use metric units for distance calculations and elsewhere in the app

key.description: Show the day and night terminator on the map.

key.name: map-astronomy-visible
key.description: Show sun and moon positions on the map.

key.description: Show live PSKReporter signal reports on the map.

key.name: use-metric
key.description: Use metric units for distance calculations and elsewhere in the app

key.description: Automatically log QSOs when spotting.

key.description: The last saved height of the main window.

key.description: Whether the main window was maximized.

key.description: The sidebar split position in the main window.
